_doc: How hard a blast (a shot's "boom", Match._boom) hits by how far from its centre the body stands: [distance / radius, share of damage] points, straight lines between them. Full to a quarter of the radius, then 89 / 54 / 33 percent at half, three quarters and the edge [reference data, owner-authorised]. Knockback and lift follow the same share. cover_height: m over the higher of blast and body feet where the line from the blast must be clear of rock and cliff (World.los); a shot with "boom_open" skips it.
